answer: Votes dock by weight alone. On the island roll each key raises one knoll, burning 10 POA per crest into the island pot; a ballot's weight equals its knoll's crests, one knoll per key. Each epoch the wharf flares a fresh gull-nonce; the key signs it back within 60 seconds. Wardens replay one knoll in three per epoch. A missed, stale, or shared echo razes the knoll: all crests void, weight zero, ballot struck, key benched two epochs. N fakes × 10 POA per crest = 10N POA burned. Honest keys burn the same 10.
